title: On the Impact of Graph Neural Networks in Recommender Systems: A Topological Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2512.07384v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In recommender systems, user-item interactions can be modeled as a bipartite graph, where user and item nodes are connected by undirected edges. This graph-based view has motivated the rapid adoption of graph neural networks (GNNs), which often outperform collaborative filtering (CF) methods such as latent factor models, deep neural networks, and generative strategies. Yet, despite their empirical success, the reasons why GNNs offer systematic advantages over other CF approaches remain only partially understood. This monograph advances a topology-centered perspective on GNN-based recommendation. We argue that a comprehensive understanding of these models' performance should consider the structural properties of user-item graphs and their interaction with GNN architectural design. To support this view, we introduce a formal taxonomy that distills common modeling patterns across eleven representative GNN-based recommendation approaches

translated_title: 论图神经网络在推荐系统中的影响：一个拓扑学视角
translated_abstract: 在推荐系统中，用户与物品之间的交互可以被建模为一个二部图，其中用户节点和物品节点通过无向边相连。这种基于图的视角推动了图神经网络（GNN）的快速应用，GNN的表现通常优于协同过滤（CF）方法，例如潜在因子模型、深度神经网络和生成式策略。然而，尽管GNN在实证上取得了成功，其相对于其他协同过滤方法具有系统性优势的原因仍未被充分理解。本专著提出了一个以拓扑为中心的GNN推荐研究视角。我们认为，要全面理解这些模型的性能，必须考虑用户-物品图的结构特性及其与GNN架构设计之间的相互作用。为支持这一观点，我们引入了一个形式化的分类体系，提炼了十一种代表性GNN推荐方法中的共同建模模式。
tldr: 本论文从拓扑学视角系统解释了图神经网络在推荐系统中优于传统协同过滤方法的根本原因，指出图结构特性与GNN架构设计的相互作用是理解其性能的关键，并建立了涵盖十一种代表性GNN推荐方法的形式化分类体系。
